name: write
description: 将内容写入文件，如已存在则覆盖。强制 read-before-overwrite：覆盖已存在文件前必须先调用 read 工具读取该文件。流式原子写入（tmp+fsync+rename，防损坏，支持大文件）+ 哈希备份（支持 undo）。大文件自动跳过 diff 以防爆内存，返回写入摘要。此操作具有破坏性。
description_en: Write content to a file, overwriting if it exists. Enforces read-before-overwrite: you must call the read tool on an existing file before overwriting it. Streaming atomic write (tmp+fsync+rename, corruption-safe, supports large files) + hash backup (undo supported). Large files automatically skip the diff to avoid memory blowup; returns a write summary. This operation is destructive.

path.description: 要写入的文件的绝对或相对路径
path.description_en: Absolute or relative path of the file to write

content.description_en: Content to write to the file

createDirs.description: 是否在父目录不存在时自动创建（默认 true）
createDirs.description_en: Whether to automatically create missing parent directories (default true)
